02 / HOW IT WORKS

Engineered
for Absolute
Privacy.

Blynq isn't just another file host. It is a purpose-built pipeline designed to protect intellectual property, large media assets, and sensitive documents from end to end.

01

Secure Upload

Drag and drop your asset. Your file is verified locally and prepared for transfer without any destructive compression.

02

Zero-Knowledge Encryption

Before leaving your device, the file is wrapped in an unbreakable encryption layer. We never have the keys to your data.

03

Decentralized Storage

The encrypted packet is distributed across high-availability nodes, ensuring it remains safe and accessible globally.

04

Frictionless Retrieval

Share your unique 6-digit code or QR link. The recipient connects, downloads, and decrypts the exact bit-for-bit original.

Move Any File. Instantly.
